mutants.description: The S_RUN window stops sampling once its count reaches a full window (saturation applied to the whole run update), so a fully faulted run window is frozen instead of rolling.
mutants.reason: With trip_run set above WINDOW_RUN (no trip), 16 faulted cycles in S_RUN followed by clear cycles leave fault_count_run_out stuck at 16 instead of falling. Lowering trip_run during the run then asserts window_trip on a history that has already cleared.

mutants.description: An overflow guard at the soft-start depth stops fault_count_ss from adding the entering sample once it reaches WINDOW_SS, but the leaving bit is still subtracted, so a full 32-cycle window followed by another faulted cycle drops the count to 31.
mutants.reason: In S_SS with a sustained overcurrent of 33 or more cycles, fault_count_ss_out falls from 32 to 31 although the window is still fully faulted. With trip_ss = 32, window_trip_SS then deasserts.
